classification_rule.DIAGNOSTIC_OWNED: execucao_id matches target AND origin matches diagnostic transport (activecampaign) AND created within execution window (inicio..fim) AND tipo/severidade/descricao consistent with diagnostic
classification_rule.PREEXISTENT: created before diagnostic window OR belongs to different origin
classification_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: diagnostic ownership cannot be proven — NEVER presumed deletable

protection_rule: Only DIAGNOSTIC_OWNED records may be considered for future compensation. PREEXISTENT and INCONCLUSIVE are expressly protected and non-deletable.
route_overlap_check: No overlap with ac_diag_compensacao_auditoria, ac_diag_transport, ac_webhook, ac_webhook_get_guard, ac_precheck, or any ac_run_round_2d2a* route
